description: Get the ordered list of what stands between a VibeMap project and being ready to build — the same walkthrough the Prepare map shows the user and the same one the in-app agent's briefs come from. Findings on their own are an unordered set, so use this instead of inventing your own priority: steps are grouped by finding kind, ordered so a fix never invalidates earlier work (access → data → surfaces → behaviour → detail → reconcile), and each carries why it matters, which map nodes it concerns, and how it is resolved (action.kind: fix | generate | reconcile | propose | navigate — `fix` and `generate` are automatic, `reconcile` and `propose` produce a change a human approves, `navigate` is a link with no automatic action). Check sources_failed — a non-empty list means some checks did not run, so an empty plan is NOT a clean bill of health. Read-only.
name: vibemap_get_review_plan
